behaviors.protocol_context: One configured SequencePaxos instance and ballot
behaviors.trigger: New election result or incoming Prepare
implementation_guards: New local leadership requires ballot greater than leader_state and stored promise; follower Prepare requires greater promise or equal promise in Recover
writes: Flush batch, store promise; leader resets LeaderState and enters Prepare; follower resets receive sequence and caches Promise
external_effects: Leader sends Prepare; follower replies with accepted round/index and conditional log sync

behaviors.protocol_context: One configured SequencePaxos instance and ballot
implementation_guards: Promise and Accepted ballot must equal leader ballot; Accepted also requires Leader/Accept; prepare and accept quorum counts use per-pid slots
writes: Prepare quorum selects maximum accepted round/index history and maximum decided index; synchronizes log, appends pending proposals unless stopped; updates own accepted slot; Accepted overwrites sender slot and may advance decided index
external_effects: AcceptSync starts a per-follower sequence session; AcceptDecide carries entries and decided index; quorum decision produces Decide or updates buffered AcceptDecide

behaviors.protocol_context: One configured SequencePaxos instance and ballot
implementation_guards: Ballot equals stored promise; AcceptSync requires Follower/Prepare; AcceptDecide and StopSign require Follower/Accept and expected sequence; Decide requires Accept and expected sequence
writes: Synchronize or append before replying; monotonically advance decided index, flushing batches if necessary; install StopSign
external_effects: Accepted acknowledges persisted accepted index; AcceptSync forwards buffered proposals if no StopSign

behaviors.execution_owner: SequencePaxos initialization, reconnected and resend handlers
behaviors.protocol_context: One configured SequencePaxos instance and ballot
behaviors.trigger: Stored promise on construction, network reconnection, sequence gap or resend timeout
implementation_guards: Reconnect to current leader enters Recover; old ballot receives NotAccepted; larger unexpected ballot requests recovery
writes: PrepareReq at leader resets sender promise and cached outgoing acceptance metadata; follower enters Recover on sequence gap
external_effects: PrepareReq, Prepare and cached Promise retransmissions; Accept-phase resend handles StopSign and unpromised peers; ordinary Accept/Accepted retransmission is not present in these branches

cross_activity_effects.A2: Recovery enables equal-ballot Prepare to rebuild follower context.
cross_activity_effects.A1: Resynchronization restarts follower acceptance from selected leader history.

facts.meaning: The stored ballot is the ballot currently promised by this replica.
facts.validity_context: Until replaced by a qualifying Prepare or local leadership transition.
facts.durability: Written through InternalStorage; backend guarantees not yet inspected.
facts.recovery: Construction reads existing promise and enters Recover.

facts.meaning: The leader records each participant's most recently assigned accepted index for its current LeaderState.
facts.validity_context: LeaderState is replaced on new local leadership; incoming current-ballot Accepted overwrites the sender slot.
facts.recovery: New leadership starts zeroed accounting and rebuilds through synchronization acknowledgments.

surfaces.reason: Ordinary final AcceptDecide or Accepted loss has no resend in these branches. Does the transport contract require reliable delivery or reconnection notification, and which other trigger restores progress?
Current-ballot Accepted overwrites rather than maximizes per-pid index. Determine whether legal delayed acknowledgments affect only conservative accounting or also trim/progress consumers.

formation.explanation: Leader preparation collects per-pid promises, selects prior history, enters Accept and synchronizes followers. Local proposals append/batch, followers acknowledge accepted indexes, and leader accepts a decision only after the configured acceptance quorum. Decision propagation uses Decide or piggybacking. Application export remains unread.

context.explanation: BLE heartbeat rounds propose leadership; SequencePaxos only initiates local leadership above its prior leader and promise. A follower persists a qualifying promise before responding, rejects old ballots and requires preparation before AcceptSync. Recovery permits same-ballot Prepare; new local leadership resets support accounting.

connection.explanation: Preparation flushes pending batches before reporting accepted history. The selected accepted round/index and decided index constrain the new leader history; pending proposals append only if no accepted StopSign. Current-ballot acceptance and per-follower message sequences qualify later advancement. Gaps request resynchronization; old ballots cannot directly append at followers.
